title: Source Metadata
description: Metadata record for a single authoritative assessment or curriculum source. Intended to describe sources discovered during ORC inventory (IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC Phase 2) and fulfilled during acquisition (Phase 3).

source_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this source, e.g. SOURCE-ORC-MATH-2025-T2-01.

subject.description: One of the six scope subjects (SYSTEM_SPEC section 6).

grade.description: Grade level targeted by the source, e.g. '11'.

document_type.description: Kind of document. Distinguishes authoritative evidence from derived material (SYSTEM_SPEC section 5).

year.description: Academic year of the source, e.g. '2025' or 2025.

paper_number.description: Paper number if applicable, e.g. 'P1' or 1.

source_url.description: URL where the source is located.

retrieved_at.description: Timestamp when the source record was created/retrieved.

access_status.description: Whether the source was accessible at discovery time. External sources must be marked 'external'.

local_path.description: Path to the preserved original file, set when acquired.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the preserved original file.

notes.description: Free-form notes, e.g. access problems, duplicates, unresolved items.
